environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on EC2 with origin access restricted through CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net) configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy. ALB security group ingress limited to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). CloudFront behavior configured with viewer request policy requiring signed URLs (Trusted Key Group: kg-report-api-2024) with 300-second TTL on signatures. The CloudFront distribution has a custom origin request policy that strips and re-encodes the request body through a Lambda@Edge origin-request function (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789:function:sanitize-report-payload) which performs recursive attribute-path detection on all string values in JSON payloads, rejecting any value containing patterns matching \{[^}]*\.[^}]*\} (dot-traversal in curly braces) or \{[^}]*\[.*\]\} (bracket access in curly braces) before forwarding to origin. Requests failing validation receive 403 with x-rejection-reason header.

config.origin_access_control: OAC policy with signing protocol SigV4
config.signed_url_requirement: Trusted Key Group kg-report-api-2024, RSA 2048-bit, 300s expiry
config.payload_validation_regex: rejects \{[^}]*\.[^}]*\} and \{[^}]*\[.*\]\} patterns in all JSON string values
